question: Which state has introduced an upgraded version of its poverty alleviation scheme called Orunodoi 2.0?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The state that has introduced an upgraded version of its poverty alleviation scheme called **Orunodoi 2.0** is **Assam**.
 
• **Orunodoi 2.0** is a revamped version of the **Orunodoi Scheme**, which is a direct benefit transfer (DBT) program aimed at helping economically disadvantaged families by providing financial support. 
 
• The updated version focuses on expanding coverage and increasing the amount of assistance provided to eligible beneficiaries.
 
• The scheme targets economically weaker sections of society, especially women-headed households.
 
• The primary beneficiaries are families who are below the poverty line (BPL), including those without a steady income source.
